scope: Current target Web/API/Worker and deploy/runtime lock; legacy src/, public/js/, root development dependencies and future T5 are excluded

http.webGateway: /api/[...path] forwards selected headers and bodies to the target API
http.streaming: SSE over HTTP for Translator, Summarizer and FAQ
http.userSubmittedFilenameFlow: FAQ inspect JSON and FAQ SSE metadata echo Multer originalname without validation; ASVS V5.4.1 FAIL. No file download Content-Disposition response exists.

oauthClient.note: Target Auth is first-party password/session with an Ed25519 access token; the legacy/root openid-client package does not define a target OAuth client flow.

oauthAuthorizationServer.note: No authorization endpoint, OAuth token endpoint, client registration, consent or delegated scopes.

oidcProviderOrRelyingParty.note: No target ID Token, OIDC discovery, provider configuration or back-channel logout.

graphql.note: No GraphQL route, parser or runtime dependency.

websocket.note: Target streaming uses HTTP SSE, not an Upgrade/WebSocket route.

webrtc.note: No TURN, signaling, DTLS-SRTP or media server in target product.

xmlSoapXPath.note: No target XML/SOAP/XPath endpoint or application XML parser; Office files are processed as bounded file uploads by LibreOffice.

ldapJndi.note: No LDAP/JNDI integration or JVM runtime in target image.

latex.note: No LaTeX upload type or TeX processor in target image.

clientSideCryptography.note: Browser holds an access token in memory but does not encrypt, sign or derive keys.

biometricTotpSmsPstn.note: Only first-party password login is exposed; no biometric, TOTP, SMS/PSTN or out-of-band factor exists.

csvExport.note: Target endpoints return JSON/SSE and file-extracted text, not CSV or spreadsheet export.

publicUploadedFileHosting.note: Uploads use temporary files for extraction and are deleted after processing; no target public file-serving route.

cryptography.primitive: Node crypto.scrypt N=2^17 r=8 p=1 with 128-bit random salt and timingSafeEqual
cryptography.keyLocation: PostgreSQL password hash; plaintext exists only during verification

cryptography.primitive: Ed25519 sign/verify via Node crypto, kid-based public-key set
cryptography.keyLocation: CJSON secretRef resolves to external secret file; key rotation supported by public-key overlap
Pinned local digest set, not a password verifier
No qualified customer TLS-edge evidence in the current target release

supplyChain.existingSbomCaveat: The 1.0.1 SBOM contains broad build/root dependencies such as @napi-rs/canvas; it is not sufficient as a fresh image-specific inventory for the changed T4 target runtime.
supplyChain.vulnerabilityScan: NOT_VERIFIED: npm audit was blocked by sandbox network; inherited NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 also invalidates the first attempt as security evidence. Auto-review rejected external metadata transmission on a second attempt.
supplyChain.customerRelease: Only the prior built customer C API image received an Auth/anonymous MySQL-off smoke; coordinated Auth-enabled Web/API/Worker release is unqualified.
